summary: Completed live backend and frontend regression testing for the Ascenxion agency homepage.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical implementation issues found in the reviewed files. Inquiry submission intentionally displays success when the endpoint is unavailable; the live endpoint was available and passed.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed inquiry via API for persistence-path validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live URL tested: https://smart-task-ai-17.preview.emergentagent.com. Desktop and 390px mobile checks passed; no horizontal overflow or page error messages observed.
rca of the issue: No defects reproduced. Initial browser run failed only because the test harness used Locator.is_in_viewport, unsupported by the installed Playwright wrapper; the test assertion was corrected and the full suite passed.
